information.description:
Humanoid Ground Drone. A humanoid drone: robot hands (BODY 8), two Subdermal Grips, Jump Boosters, radio, camera with Anti-Dazzle, LL/IR/UV and Targeting Scope. Wields any gun up to BODY 8; usually a military Saratoga with Extended Magazine (50 Armor-Piercing), an Ajax (30 Basic) or a Kyubi (20 Basic).

Cost: 30,000eb
MOVE: 4
HP: 35
SP: 15
CN: 14
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
